svg.title: Create Materials
svg.desc: Create Materials Create custom materials for weight calculations. Allows the user to create and define materials by specifying the properties required for subsequent weight calculations. Material Definition:Creates new materials with their corresponding density. Custom Database:Allows project-specific materials to be added for later use.
